title: Beef meatball and green bean traybake

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is a plain whole food or a cheese, and there are no jars, pots or packet mixes.

supermarket.reason: New potatoes, celery, beef mince, Parmesan, cherry tomatoes, green beans and basil are all everyday Tesco items at normal prices.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a roasting tray, a grater and a knife, and rolling meatballs is well within a beginner's reach.

works.reason: 500g mince makes 20 meatballs for four, and 22 to 25 minutes at 220°C cooks them through, with Parmesan for salt and the tomatoes giving juice.

honest_times.reason: Twenty minutes covers halving the potatoes, slicing the celery, rolling the meatballs and trimming the beans, and 15 + 10 + 15 matches the 40 minutes of cooking.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including the basil and oregano, is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: A light summer traybake of new potatoes, cherry tomatoes and green beans suits mid-July, and the beans are a main component, not a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English.

hearty_healthy.reason: Meatballs, potatoes and plenty of vegetables make a proper family dinner.
